goal: Collapse the mechanical replan succession sequence (stop current task, release backend claim, author a same-scope successor TaskIntent, enroll) into a single Pi TUI command behind exactly one literal-user confirmation, eliminating repeated multi-command round trips when a task exhausts its Review follow-up limit.

acceptance.assertion: A new Pi TUI command, valid only when the enrolled task carries replan_required, executes predecessor stop with backend claim release, successor TaskIntent derivation preserving scope_hint and verification descriptors with only task identity and succession goal text changed, canonical intent validation, and atomic enrollment as one linearized operation under the workspace lock; cancellation before the commit point guarantees zero authority writes, cancellation after commit is rejected with authority application proceeding; crash recovery accepts only all-before or all-after states; exactly one literal-user confirmation displays the stop, release, derive, and enroll payload before any mutation; the settled result leaves exactly one active task, the successor, with the predecessor terminal.

The enrollment authority boundary documentation, command help, and contract tests consistently describe the successor route alongside the existing candidate and waiver routes, preserving the Git-tracked TaskIntent requirement, revalidation, and atomic enrollment semantics with no divergence between source and packaged artifacts.
The complete Pi extension graph passes strict TypeScript checking and the full repository test suite passes with no regressions.
